title: AI-DLC Course Module
description: Shape of one object in the MODS array in course/index.html. body is a JS template-literal HTML string.

id.description: Module ID, e.g. M05. Must exist in curriculum-map.md.

minutes.description: Estimated completion time including the lab.

body.description: HTML string. Section order: p.hook, 2-4 h2 concept sections with >=1 inline SVG (viewBox set, CSS-variable colors) and exactly one aside.analogy (Lakeview build beat, 60-120 words, with the maps-to line) after the first or second section, optional table.bridge, section.lab (dual-path with .engine-tabs), section.recap.
